overviewParagraphs: Angkor Golf Resort stands unchallenged as Cambodia's premier golf destination — a Sir Nick Faldo design positioned just minutes from the ancient temples of Angkor Wat in Siem Reap, combining world-class golf architecture with one of the most extraordinary cultural backdrops found anywhere on earth. Playing here is a genuinely immersive experience; the spires of twelfth-century temple complexes are visible from multiple vantage points across the course.

Faldo's design is characteristically strategic and demanding: wide enough to be rewarding for visiting resort golfers, but with sufficient precision required off key tees and into several well-defended greens to provide the championship examination that serious players want. The course is maintained to a standard that rivals Thailand's very best, which given Cambodia's relative youth as a golf tourism destination is genuinely remarkable.

AGS regards Angkor Golf Resort as the centrepiece of any Cambodia golf itinerary — the combination of Sir Nick Faldo's design, Angkor Wat proximity, and the cultural depth of Siem Reap makes it one of the most compelling golf travel propositions in all of Southeast Asia for discerning golfers seeking the genuinely extraordinary.

curatorBriefHtml: Angkor Golf Resort (opened 2008 by Sir Nick Faldo, just 10 minutes from downtown Siem Reap and 15 minutes from Angkor Wat) is Cambodia’s #1 championship golf experience and a perennial bucket-list stop for international golfers. Measuring 6,666 yards from the Blue Tees (7,279 yards Championship, Par 72), Faldo routed wide, inviting Paspalum fairways into heavily guarded, subtly contoured greens framed by dramatic water hazards and signature sculpted bunkering.

Having played Angkor Golf Resort personally, the conditioning, caddie warmth, and seamless proximity to Siem Reap’s finest sanctuaries — including Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor, Zannier Phum Baitang, and Jaya House River Park — make it one of Asia’s ultimate morning-golf, afternoon-temple pairings.
Angkor Golf Resort anchors our Cambodia Angkor Odyssey and Khmer Temple Trail itineraries, pairing effortlessly with Phokeethra Country Club.

scorecard.gradeBadge: Sir Nick Faldo Cambodia Masterpiece • Siem Reap
scorecard.verdict: The undisputed premier championship golf course in Cambodia. Sir Nick Faldo sculpted a tactical paradise just minutes from Angkor Wat. Impeccable conditioning, bold bunker shapes, and elite caddie service make this an essential bucket-list round.

faqs.q: How close is Angkor Golf Resort to Angkor Wat and Siem Reap hotels?
faqs.a: Angkor Golf Resort is just 10–15 minutes from downtown Siem Reap luxury hotels (Raffles, Jaya House, Amansara) and 15 minutes from the Angkor Archaeological Park — making a morning round + afternoon temple tour effortless.

faqs.q: What style of test did Sir Nick Faldo build at Angkor Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Faldo created generous driving corridors that welcome resort golfers off the tee, paired with strategically placed water hazards, deep sculpted bunkers, and subtle, fast Paspalum greens that reward sharp approach play.

faqs.q: How many rounds should we play in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Most AGS guests spend 4 to 5 nights in Siem Reap playing 2 rounds at Angkor Golf Resort plus 1 round at Phokeethra Country Club, leaving ample time for sunrise at Angkor Wat and private temple touring.

faqs.q: When is the best season to golf in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: November through March is Cambodia’s dry high season (24–32°C) with crisp mornings and zero rain delays.
